_help: Final scores as games finish, keyed by game number from wjc.json, for example { "1": { "a": 4, "b": 1 }, "2": { "a": 3, "b": 2, "ot": "OT" } }. a is the first team listed, b the second. ot is OT or SO when decided after regulation (the winner is the higher score). The forecast then plays out only the remaining games.
